title: Home Comfort Financing Post-Promotional Interest — Payment-Record Relief
content:
A Home Comfort Financing borrower's recent payment record earns a post-promotional payment-record relief. The post-promotional payment-record relief counts the payments posted less than 12 whole months before the date of handling less the returned payments posted in that time: it is 10 percent when that count is at least 12, 5 percent when the count is at least 6 but below 12, and zero when the count is below 6.

## Condition — judgement — result

- **Condition:** payments posted on the account less than 12 whole months before the date of handling, and returned-payment entries posted in the same span.
- **Judgement:** the number of payments less the number of returned payments.
- **Result:** 12 or more — 10 percent; 6 to 11 — 5 percent; below 6 — zero.

The relief is one of the post-promotional reliefs, which are added together into the post-promotional relief percentage; the plan's post-promotional APR is reduced once by that total, and the reliefs never act one after another.

## Cases (hypothetical accounts)

| Payments in the last 12 whole months | Returned payments in the same span | Count | Relief |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 | 0 | 12 | 10 percent |
| 12 | 1 | 11 | 5 percent |
| 6 | 0 | 6 | 5 percent |
| 8 | 3 | 5 | zero |

A payment posted 13 months before the date of handling is outside the span and is not counted; neither is a returned-payment entry posted that long ago.
